description.zh: SDG部署类型，取值shared表示读写分离共享部署，SDG内容只读，数据更新内容写入实例本地。
description.en: The deployment type of the SDG. shared: shared read/write splitting deployment. The content of the SDG is read-only, and data updates are written to the local storage of the instance.

description.zh:
云盘访问协议类型：

- iscsi：标准云盘默认协议，rbd云盘和标准云盘都支持该协议。

 - rbd：rbd云盘默认协议，只有rbd云盘支持该挂载协议。
description.en:
The protocol type for disk access:

- iscsi: The default protocol for standard disks. Both RBD disks and standard disks support this protocol.

- rbd: The default protocol for RBD disks. Only RBD disks support this mount protocol.

description.zh:
生产的共享盘磁盘类型：

- standard(标准云盘)。
- rbd（rbd云盘）。

> 
> - 不指定共享盘磁盘类型时默认生成标准云盘。
> - 仅母盘类型为rbd时支持生成rbd共享盘。
description.en:
The disk type of the shared disk to be generated:

- standard (standard disk).

- rbd (RBD disk).

> * If the shared disk type is not specified, a standard disk is generated by default.
>
> * RBD shared disks can be generated only when the source disk type is RBD.

description.zh: 实例的编号列表。参数为一个带有格式的JSON数组，最多100个ID。
description.en: The IDs of the instances. The value is a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens deploy-instance-sdg --instance-ids aic-1 --sdg-id sdg-xxxx --deployment-type shared --disk-type standard --disk-access-protocol iscsi --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DeployInstanceSDG --region cn-hangzhou --SDGId 'sdg-xxxx' --DiskType standard --DeploymentType shared --DiskAccessProtocol iscsi --InstanceIds '["aic-1"]'
